name: Review serve_file.py for path traversal
prompt: Review serve_file.py for security issues. Do NOT modify any code — this is a read-only review task. Write your findings to REVIEW.md in this repository. In particular, check whether a caller-supplied filename could escape the intended directory. REVIEW.md must identify the issue by name.
test_command: import pathlib; t=pathlib.Path('REVIEW.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8').lower(); assert 'traversal' in t, 'REVIEW.md must identify the path-traversal issue'
